mapper.sql: id, name, code, title_label AS titleLabel, is_system AS isSystem, list_template AS listTemplate, detail_template AS detailTemplate, icon, description, sort, status, use_content AS useContent, use_seo AS useSeo, enable_comment AS enableComment, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime
mapper.insert: insert into fly_model (name, code, title_label, is_system, list_template, detail_template, icon, description, sort, status, create_time) values (#{name}, #{code}, #{titleLabel}, #{isSystem}, #{listTemplate}, #{detailTemplate}, #{icon}, #{description}, #{sort}, #{status}, now())
mapper.select: select from fly_model where code = #{code} limit 1
select count(*) > 0 from fly_model where code = #{code}
select from fly_model order by sort asc, id desc limit #{offset}, #{rows}
